Found 5 matching tool(s). These are now exposed and ready to call:

- `build_miniapp`: Build MiniApp — Validate and build a MiniApp package using the original host SDK. Expo uses Metro; NativeScript emits an ESM source graph for its original shared Core runtime; ScriptWidget preserves source for its original widget compiler. Successful output includes archivePath and retained sources for repair. Does not compile new native frameworks. [source: native]
- `import_miniapp`: Import MiniApp — Send a built local archive directly to Hanlin MiniApps for its actual importer. The initial receipt may be queued; query transfer_id to receive the actual installed or failed result. Never describe queued as installed. [source: native]
- `validate_miniapp`: Validate MiniApp — Typecheck an entire MiniApp source project with the original TypeScript compiler and installed host SDK. Returns structured diagnostics including code, file and one-based line/column. For a source-preserving imported package, project_path may point at the extracted archive root. Does not execute the MiniApp. [source: native]
- `write_miniapp`: Write MiniApp sources — Create or edit MiniApp sources and binary assets directly. Each files item has a relative path and exactly one UTF-8 content or base64. Omit project_path for a new writable project. For an extracted archive root, edits automatically target its retained sourceRoot; unrelated files remain unchanged. Validate and rebuild after editing. [source: native]
- `get_miniapp_sdk`: MiniApp SDK — Read the original Expo, NativeScript and ScriptWidget APIs, types, package versions and documentation packaged with this installed host. Pass resource to read a file from the returned SDK. Use these exact types before authoring. [source: native]
